host_read_wait_boundary: Overlaps step walltime; host read calls include pending device work, finite-reduction kernels, synchronization and transfer; not pure synchronization latency
limitations: Decoded matrices, latent parameters, gradients, moments, host copies and allocator/runtime memory coexist; packed payload is not total training memory
PeakRSS is process high-water mark across runs, not isolated per-model allocation; sampled GPU memory can miss peaks
No energy, inference throughput or total-memory saving claim

parameter_accounting_bytes.boundary: Analytic numerical payload counts, not allocator telemetry or simultaneous peak residency; update proposals, previous state and replay model may coexist
parameter_accounting_bytes.packed_export_residency: Hypothetical immutable export payload for ternary mode; packed matrices are not retained by either training model

synchronization: loss read, 16 finite-check scalar reads, plus two weight and two activation reads per ternary forward; timed inside training_step_seconds. JSON checkpoints/evaluation/resume comparisons add host reads and are included in wall_seconds.
